Bonfire rules

You may burn dry garden waste on your own plot between the first of October and the end of March, and never on a Sunday. Keep the bonfire small, stay with it until it is out, and do not burn anything when the wind blows towards the houses. The rules are there so that the neighbours can keep their windows open.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
